docs.title: Classification
docs.text: Echelon: Platoon sergeant / medical corporal Type: Casualty evacuation / triage under fire Decision time: 4 minutes Source: Original design — SANDF context

docs.title: Situation
docs.text:
It is 10:15, 18°C, moderate wind reducing visibility to 500 m in dust. Your infantry platoon is conducting a search-and-clear in the Maluleke area (bushveld, rocky kopjes, dense scrub). You are the platoon sergeant moving with 2IC and the medic corporal at the centre of the formation.

At 10:12, Section 1 (lead element, 4 men) triggers an RPG ambush at a rocky kopje 150 m north of your position. Return fire is immediate. The platoon commander has taken splinter wounds to the right shoulder and is unable to command.

Situation report from 2IC:

"Section 1 has 2 casualties: Rifleman Dlamini — GSA to chest, not breathing. Rifleman van der Merwe — GSA to left leg, conscious, bleeding. One enemy RPG position suppressed. Enemy strength unknown. Small arms fire from kopje continues. Medic is with me. Platoon commander down."

Your platoon layout:

Element Position Status Section 1 North, at ambush site 2 casualties, contact Section 2 South, not engaged 8 men, intact Section 3 East, flank security 8 men, not engaged Platoon HQ Centre, 150 m south of contact You + 2IC + medic, intact Company main 800 m south, not yet committed Company HQ + reserve

You have one ambulance (Rooikat armoured ambulance) attached, currently at company HQ.

docs.title: Map Sketch
docs.text:
NORTH ↑
[Rocky kopje] ← Section 1 contact (150 m)
   ↑   ↑
   |   |
 Enemy RPG  Your casualties
   |   |
   ↓   ↓
[Section 2] ← Bushveld, 200 m west
[Platoon HQ] ← Your position
   |
   ↓
[Section 3] ← East flank, 200 m
   |
   ↓
[Company main] ← 800 m south

Key terrain: - Rocky kopje provides enemy defilade; RPG team likely in a cave/crevice. - Bushveld between kopje and platoon HQ limits vehicle movement. - No casualty collection point established yet. - Medic has 2× personal aid kits, 1× morphine, no stretcher.

docs.title: Commander's Intent (Company)
docs.text: "Clear the ambush site. Recover casualties if feasible. Continue to objective DELTA. Report status to company HQ within 10 minutes."

docs.title: Higher Constraints
docs.text:
• No medevac helicopter available for 45 minutes.
  • Armoured ambulance is not armoured against RPG; approach route is exposed.
  • Company reserve is not yet committed; company CO has not approved casualty recovery operation.
  • ROE: protect wounded; recover if tactically feasible; do not break contact to do so.
  • Two casualties: one expectant (Dlamini, chest wound, not breathing), one urgent (van der Merwe, leg wound, bleeding).

docs.title: Decision Required
docs.text:
What do you do in the next 4 minutes?

Write: (a) your decision, (b) two-sentence rationale, (c) next three branches.

docs.title: Minimum Acceptable Standard
docs.text:
1. Assume command — you are now the senior surviving leader; declare yourself platoon commander.
  2. Report to company HQ immediately — 2IC or medic radios status and your decision.
  3. Establish a Casualty Collection Point (CCP) 100 m south of contact, in cover.
  4. Send Section 2 to suppress RPG position with flanking fire; do not send Section 2 to recover Dlamini without contact broken.
  5. Medic treats van der Merwe first — tourniquet, morphine, prepare for CASEVAC.
  6. Request armoured ambulance from company HQ with security element.
  7. Dlamini is expectant — medic confirms; focus resources on salvageable casualty.

docs.title: Likely Errors and How to Adjudicate Them
docs.text: Error Severity Reasoning Send Section 2 to recover Dlamini immediately FAIL Breaks contact; more casualties; violates intent Abandon Dlamini without confirmation MARGINAL Pragmatic but medic should verify expectant status Withdraw entire platoon MARGINAL Abandons contact; loses initiative Assume command + report + establish CCP + request CASEVAC PASS Standard platoon sergeant drill Move entire platoon to kopje FAIL Exposes to RPG; no clear objective

docs.title: Recommended Inject Variants
docs.text:
1. Medic reports: "Dlamini has faint pulse — he is salvageable." — Decision box restarts; both casualties are now urgent.
  2. Enemy withdraws: RPG position abandoned; Section 1 secures kopje. — Full casualty recovery now feasible.
  3. Company orders: "Platoon must continue to objective DELTA in 15 minutes." — Time pressure on CASEVAC.

docs.text:

docs.title: TDG-05: "Silent Net — HQ Under EW Attack"
Classification
docs.text: Echelon: Company second-in-command / signals officer Type: Communications / EW disruption / command post drill Decision time: 5 minutes Source: Original design — SANDF context

docs.title: Situation
docs.text:
It is 11:40, 24°C, clear. Your mechanised company is executing a movement to contact in the Waterberg bushveld. You are the company 2IC travelling with the company HQ element: Ratel-25 command vehicle, signals corporal with VHF/UHF radios, Samil 100 signals vehicle, and two Ratel-20 security sections.

At 11:35, all VHF platoon nets went dead simultaneously. The signals corporal reports:

"No transmission on any VHF channel. Receivers show static only — no jamming tone, just noise. UHF to battalion still up. I think we are under wideband noise attack or a repeater is down."

Two minutes later, battalion UHF net reports:

"Company Alpha — your last SITREP was received. All other companies report normal comms. Check your systems."

You have not received a SITREP from Platoon 1 (advance guard) for 18 minutes. You do not know if Platoon 1 is still moving, in contact, or cut off.

Your company is currently spread over 2.5 km along a single dirt road. The terrain is rocky ridge line on the north, dense bush on the south. No cell coverage. No alternate communication method pre-briefed.

docs.title: Forces
docs.text:
Friendly — Your Company HQ | Asset | Status | |---|---| | Ratel-25 command vehicle | Intact, UHF only | | Signals corporal + Samil 100 | VHF down, UHF operational | | Platoon 1 | Unknown — last contact 18 min ago | | Platoon 2 | VHF intermittent, 2 km behind | | Platoon 3 | VHF operational, 1 km behind | | Battalion HQ | UHF contact, 8 km south |

Enemy — Assessed | Capability | Assessment | |---|---| | EW team | Likely light; noise jammer range ~5 km | | Direct fire | Unknown; no contact yet | | Recon | Likely observing HQ movement |

docs.title: Map Sketch
docs.text:
NORTH ↑
[Rocky ridge line] ← enemy observation likely
   ↑
   |
  Platoon 1 ← VHF dead, unknown status (18 min)
   |
  Company HQ ← Your position (Ratel-25 + Samil 100)
   |
  Platoon 2 ← VHF intermittent
   |
  Platoon 3 ← VHF operational
   |
   ↓
[Battalion HQ] ← UHF contact, 8 km

Key terrain: - Rocky ridge on north offers enemy observation and EW site; dominant terrain. - Single dirt road limits maneuver; company is in a column formation — vulnerable to ambush if Platoon 1 is engaged. - No dead ground within 500 m for HQ displacement. - UHF to battalion is clean — this is a VHF-specific disruption, not a total comms failure.

docs.title: Commander's Intent (Battalion)
docs.text: "Company Alpha advances to phase line EAGLE. Contact and report. Maintain cohesion. Battalion reserve is 5 km behind."

docs.title: Higher Constraints
docs.text:
• No pre-briefed alternate communication plan — battalion expected VHF to be sufficient.
  • No cell phones in the field; no satellite phones at company level.
  • Runner protocol is authorized but slow through bushveld.
  • EW team location unknown — could be on ridge, could be vehicle-mounted ahead.
  • ROE: engage if engaged; report all contacts; do not split company without commander approval.

docs.title: Decision Required
docs.text:
What do you do in the next 5 minutes?

Write: (a) your decision, (b) two-sentence rationale, (c) next three branches.

docs.title: Minimum Acceptable Standard
docs.text:
1. Establish UHF net with all platoons immediately — UHF is confirmed working; use it as alternate until VHF restored.
  2. Send runner to Platoon 1 with written orders and request situation report via runner return.
  3. Deploy one security section to north ridge to clear enemy EW site or establish observation.
  4. Task signals corporal to locate jammer using direction-finding equipment; request EW team support from battalion.
  5. Issue fragmentary order to all platoon commanders via UHF: "Hold present position, establish security, report status."
  6. Do not advance until Platoon 1 status is confirmed and VHF is restored or alternate comms established.

docs.title: Likely Errors and How to Adjudicate Them
docs.text: Error Severity Reasoning Continue advance without Platoon 1 FAIL Violates intent; company may be piecemealed Send HQ forward to find Platoon 1 MARGINAL Risky; HQ should not be forward in contact Withdraw to last known safe position MARGINAL Safe but loses momentum; intent requires advance Use UHF + runner + security section + DF PASS Restores C2; preserves company integrity Assume Platoon 1 is destroyed FAIL Catastrophising; no evidence; violates command responsibility

docs.title: Recommended Inject Variants
docs.text:
1. Runner returns: "Platoon 1 is in contact, holding. One Ratel damaged. Request support." — Decision box restarts with confirmed contact.
  2. EW team located: Direction-finding pinpoints jammer 3 km north on ridge. — Direct action vs. bypass dilemma.
  3. Battalion cancels advance: Orders change; company now has defensive mission. — Comms disruption becomes less critical; focus shifts to defence.
